documents.title: Documents and quotes
documents.description: Upload and organize all the important documents for your event.
documents.infoDescription: Keep quotes, contracts, invoices, receipts and certificates together in one secure place.

tips.1: Upload quotes as soon as you receive them so you can compare them
tips.2: Link each document to the relevant supplier
tips.3: Use the Contract category for signed documents
tips.4: Keep receipts and invoices for your final accounts
tips.5: Filter by category to find files quickly
tips.6: Supported formats: PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, PNG (maximum 10 MB)

events.wedding: Organize venue, catering, photographer, florist, attire, music and ceremony documents.
events.baptism: Store baptism certificates, quotes, contracts and invoices.
events.birthday: Keep birthday contracts, quotes and invoices.
events.graduation: Store graduation bookings, quotes, contracts and invoices.

documents.agendaDescription: Organize inspections, deadlines and meetings linked to your documents.
documents.uploadHelper: Select files or drag them here
documents.uploadFormats: PDF, Word, images • Maximum 10 MB per file
documents.emptyDescription: Upload your first quote or contract to start your archive.
documents.emptyCategoryDescription: Choose another category to view available documents.
